You're a couple of linderlings from the lost planet of eternal treasure?|Melna and Fern|audio=Melna-Fern-Linderlings-SC2.flac|}} '''Melna''' was a [[Theelin]] [[Gender|female]] who worked as a dancer at a [[Unidentified dance club|dance club]] on the [[asteroid]] [[Borgo Prime|Port Borgo]]. After spotting a [[Skeleton Crew|group]] of [[Youngling|children]] outside the club around [[9 ABY]], she became concerned for their safety in the [[pirate]]-infested [[Spaceport|port]] and followed some of them, stopping the children [[Fern]] and [[KB]] to try and aid them. When the girls claimed to be from the mythical [[planet]] [[At Attin]], Melna did not believe them and assumed they were lying while on the run. She tried to drag them with her and find them [[transport]], but eventually the girls separated from the Theelin in order to help the other two children, [[Wim]] and [[Neel]], who were being chased by pirates. ==Biography== {{Quote|Who brought you here?''"
"''We brought ourselves. Why?''"
"''Honey, Borgo is full of the nastiest pirates in the sector. It's not safe here for children.|Melna and Fern|audio=Melna-Fern-Pirates-SC2.flac|}} [[File:MelnaDanceClub-SC1.png|thumb|right|300px|Melna worked at a dance club on Port Borgo.]] Melna was a [[Theelin]] [[Gender|female]] who worked as a [[door girl]] and dancer at a cabaret{{Databank|melna|Melna}} [[Unidentified dance club|dance club]] on the [[pirate]]-run [[asteroid]] [[Borgo Prime|Port Borgo]] during the [[New Republic Era|reign]] of the [[New Republic]] around [[9 ABY]].{{SkeletonCrewDate}} The Theelin was working the door alongside another [[Unidentified door girl|door girl]] while trying to entice customers to enter the club when a [[Skeleton Crew|group]] of [[Youngling|children]] paused outside the establishment. The group were searching for directions to their [[homeworld]], [[At Attin]], and briefly considered asking at the club before moving on. When the [[human]] child [[Fern]] became separated from the others, Melna watched her with concern and then followed her. After Fern reunited with her friend [[KB]], Melna ran up to them and grabbed them by the shoulders, crouching down to confirm that they were only children. Pulling them into a nearby [[Unidentified pet store|pet store]] kiosk, she asked who had brought them to the [[Spaceport|port]], explaining how unsafe it was for children and planning to get them to a [[transport]] so they could escape. When the girls revealed that they had arrived on their own [[Onyx Cinder|ship]] and simply needed directions home, the Theelin asked where that was, but scoffed when the children claimed to be from At Attin, as the [[Planet|world]] was commonly considered a myth. The two children resisted Melna's attempt to pull them along, believing she was trying to kidnap them. [[File:MelnaFernKBHiding-SC-WayWayOut.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Melna tried to help Fern and KB escape from Port Borgo, but the children resisted.]] When KB complained that the Theelin was hurting her [[Limb|arm]], the door girl stopped and explained that the children needed a better story than At Attin if they were running from something. Fern maintained that it was their homeworld, but Melna remained skeptical. The trio were then distracted by cries for aid from the other two children from At Attin, [[Wim]] and [[Neel]], who were being chased by a [[Silvo's pirates|group]] of pirates. Fern and KB then separated from Melna to aid them, but the four children were captured by the pirates and thrown in the [[brig]]. ==Personality and traits== {{Dialogue|Melna|I'm trying to help you.|Fern|You're trying to kidnap us.|KB|You're hurting my arm.|attr=Melna tries to aid a resistant Fern and KB|audio=Melna-Fern-KB-HelpYou-SC2.flac|src=}} [[File:MelnaWorried-SC1.png|thumb|right|300px|Melna worried for the children she saw on Port Borgo.]] Melna was concerned for the safety of the children she saw on Port Borgo, leaving her post to try and get them to safety and persisting even when they tried to resist her help. Despite their insistence, she refused to believe that they were from At Attin, assuming it was a cover story for whatever they were running away from. The Theelin had light skin with [[Color|blue]] dots, brown [[eye]]s, and blue [[hair]]. ==Equipment== While promoting the club, Melna wore a dark turquoise [[jumpsuit]] with matching [[glove]]s. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|Honored to be a part of the Star Wars universe. Shooting on the volume, working with the amazing David Lowery and the incredible cast of Skeleton Crew was an absolute dream.|Paloma Garcia-Lee on Instagram|{{Instagram|username=palomagarcialee|url=p/DDGWkDavd8b|name=Paloma Garcia-Lee|date=2024-12-3|quote=Honored to be a part of the Star Wars universe. Shooting on the volume, working with the amazing David Lowery and the incredible cast of Skeleton Crew was an absolute dream.|archivedate=2024-12-3|archiveurl=https://archive.is/EsJ7}}}} Melna was portrayed by [[Paloma Garcia-Lee]] in "[[Way, Way Out Past the Barrier]]," the second episode of the live-action [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: Skeleton Crew]]'', which aired on [[December 2]], [[2024]].{{SW|url=news/skeleton-crew-premiere-date|text=''Star Wars: Skeleton Crew'' Will Debut Early|date=2024-11-26}} Garcia-Lee filmed in [[Wikipedia:StageCraft|the Volume]] for the show and worked with [[David Lowery]], the episode's director.
